metadata.source: Glen Rock Board of Education User-Friendly Budget (NJ DOE)

majorAppropriations.details: Salaries for 230+ certified classroom teachers, reading specialists, and STEM educators across 4 elementary schools, Glen Rock Middle School, and Glen Rock High School.
Medical, prescription, dental insurance, and state pension contributions for active and retired educators.
In-district resource rooms, speech/occupational therapies, and specialized regional tuition via South Bergen Jointure Commission.
Custodial staffing, HVAC ventilation, school security vestibules, and energy efficiency upgrades across 6 district campuses.
School psychologists, social workers, student assistance counselors (SAC), and college guidance departments.
Superintendent of Schools, Business Administrator, curriculum directors, and legal/auditing fees.
Mandated special education transportation, sports team travel, and contracted bus routes.
